NSE Launches New Thematic Index Focused on Responsible Business Practices

NSE Indices has launched a new thematic index, Nifty500 Ahimsa, designed to provide exposure to companies demonstrating a commitment to responsible and sustainable business principles. The index draws its constituents from the Nifty 500 universe, ensuring broad sectoral representation. This initiative aims to align investment with ethical business practices.
